Zydus Lifesciences traded flat at Rs 1193.60 on the NSE at 10.52 am, rising to Rs 1,194.70 from the previous close of Rs 1,191.

The company posted a 72% rise in consolidated net profit to ₹86.29 crore in the June quarter compared with the year-ago period
